focus: disabled-by-default signed plugin intake with permission isolation and rollback
workflow: Lock the intended platform use and acceptance criteria for disabled-by-default signed plugin intake with permission isolation and rollback
Validate input identity, permissions, schema, versions and SHA-256 lineage before execution
Execute deterministic positive, negative, corruption, recovery and scale fixtures in an isolated workspace
Verify security boundaries, least privilege, fail-closed behaviour and rollback paths
Run reliability, performance, concurrency and reproducibility checks with pinned dependencies
Export a signed qualification bundle and activate monitoring only after formal review
reliability_gates: All mandatory contracts and schemas validate
Positive golden fixture produces deterministic expected output
Negative and corruption fixtures are rejected safely
Retry, recovery or rollback path is exercised
Concurrent execution does not corrupt shared state
Output artifacts are complete and SHA-256 verified
A second run is reproducible or explains approved nondeterminism
Resource limits and timeout behaviour are enforced
security_gates: Unsafe paths, commands and payloads are blocked
Secrets and sensitive content are excluded from logs and exports
Tampering or signature mismatch produces a fail-closed decision
Audit events contain actor, timestamp, version and decision provenance
acceptance_criteria: No critical integrity, security or provenance failure
All required runtime components and policy references are qualified
All deterministic golden and adverse fixtures pass
Recovery, rollback and concurrency tests pass
Monitoring thresholds and ownership are approved
Independent Windows qualification and formal release review are complete for controlled release
required_outputs: Runtime and dependency bill of materials
boundary: Plugin Marketplace Core is internally qualified as a software/platform capability only. Controlled production release remains fail-closed until independent Windows execution, security/accessibility review, operating history and formal approval are attached.
